note: Resort and travel. The classic photo spots of holiday shoots (cliff-top sea views, palm beaches, overwater decks, infinity pools, whitewashed lanes), built as original generic places rather than any real resort, island or town. Every desc places the main elements left, right and far and ends on an empty standing spot about 4 m from the camera, on dry ground well back from any edge or water; the below view shows mostly sky, so every keep names the horizon and the tallest silhouettes (docs/scene/PLAN.md §3).
